full_judgment:
2. It is stated that opposite party No. 1 made an application under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for preemption of the case land transferred by a deed being No. 1792 dated 23-4-1995. 

 9. The proceeding initiated under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 is a summary one. Such application for preemption can never be termed as a plaint. Further, taking evidence upon such application for deciding the consideration of the transfer is serious abuse of process of the Court.
